hook: Your outstretched thumbnail covers at least 10,000 galaxies.
title: Your Thumbnail Covers 10,000 Galaxies
description:
Hubble stared at one tiny, dark patch of sky for days. The Ultra Deep Field image revealed about 10,000 galaxies in that spot, which is smaller than your thumbnail at arm's length. Every dot in it is a whole galaxy.

#Shorts #Hubble #SpaceFacts
comment_prompt: Are we alone in all that? Yes or no
